weather_director.configuration.title: Weather Director
weather_director.configuration.controlCl: Weather decides how much of the sky the clouds cover, how grey they are and where they drift (Better Clouds).
weather_director.configuration.shapeClou: Rain clouds sit lower and form a thicker deck.
weather_director.configuration.keepCloud: Distant Horizons switches the game's clouds off when it starts; turn them back on once per session. A manual 'Clouds: Off' is kept.
weather_director.configuration.shaderWea: Shader packs that read Weather Director's uniforms draw the same cloud cover, grey sky, fog and drift. Packs that do not read them are not affected.
weather_director.configuration.greySkies: Overcast and rainy weather greys the sky and hides the sun and stars.
weather_director.configuration.seasonalS: Seasonal sky tint, sunrise and sunset colours, clearer winter stars.
weather_director.configuration.windOnRai: Rain and snow fall at an angle with the wind (Particle Rain).
weather_director.configuration.lightDriz: Light rain draws fewer drops than heavy rain (Particle Rain).
weather_director.configuration.groundFog: Mist and fog lie on the ground as soft fog (Particle Rain's fog particles).
Also scaled by the vanilla Particles setting (Decreased = half, Minimal = none).
weather_director.configuration.particleB: No new ground fog while Particle Rain already has this many particles alive.
weather_director.configuration.viewFog.t: Fog, thunderstorms and being inside a cloud shorten how far you can see.
weather_director.configuration.cloudLaye: No rain above the cloud deck, fog inside it.
weather_director.configuration.windSound: Hear the wind (AmbientSounds' recordings, needs AmbientSounds): louder when it blows harder, in the open and up high, quieter and muffled indoors, silent in caves. Needs a restart.
weather_director.configuration.windVolum: How loud the wind is. It also follows the game's Weather volume slider.
weather_director.configuration.rainFollo: Rain and snow sounds are soft in drizzle and full in heavy rain (vanilla, AmbientSounds, Particle Rain).
weather_director.configuration.indoorWin: The wind sounds different under a roof and indoors: quieter and duller.
weather_director.configuration.muffleInd: Rain and thunder are quieter under a roof and indoors, thunder sounds duller inside, and both are silent deep underground.
weather_director.configuration.thunderDe: Thunder comes after the flash, later the further away the strike.
